services.name: Daily Cruises
services.desc: Knoxville’s best-kept secret isn’t on land, it’s on the water. Step onto the Volunteer Princess and join us for any one of our daily public river cruises. Whether you’re soaking in the glow on a sunset sightseeing cruise, taking in the scenery on an afternoon lunch cruise, or cruising into golden hour on a sunset dinner cruise, it’s an unforgettable way to spend your day. This isn’t your average outing, it’s your chance to relax, enjoy the views, and create some epic memories. So grab your crew, channel your inner explorer, and let’s hit the river. No FOMO (fear of missing out) here, just good times on the Tennessee River! Knoxville sunsets are already pretty sweet, but they’re way cooler

services.name: Private Charters
services.desc: Corporate meetings don’t have to feel like a snooze fest, and special occasions deserve more than the same old banquet hall. That’s where the Volunteer Princess steps in. Whether you’re hosting a buttoned-up business event or a blowout birthday bash, our Knoxville private charters bring just the right mix of style and fun to make your event unforgettable. From award banquets and networking events to anniversaries and family reunions, we’ll work with you to plan the perfect gathering. Think dazzling riverfront views, a chef-crafted menu tailored to your group, a fully stocked bar, and AV capabilities so you can nail that presentation or play the embarrassing slideshow. With room for 2 to 132
